description: This file defines the Menu model class in the Opencart admin module, providing methods for managing menu records in the database, including CRUD operations and handling descriptions.

classes.name: Menu
classes.description: Model class for managing menu data in the Opencart admin system, including creation, editing, deletion, and retrieval of menus and their descriptions.

methods.name: addMenu
methods.description: Creates a new menu record in the database and adds its descriptions.

methods.name: editMenu
methods.description: Updates an existing menu record and its descriptions.

methods.name: deleteMenu
methods.description: Deletes a menu record and its associated descriptions.

methods.name: deleteMenuByCode
methods.description: Deletes menus matching the specified code and their descriptions.

methods.name: getMenu
methods.description: Retrieves a menu record by ID, including its description for the current language.

methods.name: getMenuByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a menu record by code for the current language.

methods.name: getMenus
methods.description: Retrieves all menus with descriptions, indexed by code.

methods.name: getTotalMenus
methods.description: Returns the total count of menu records.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description entry for a specific menu and language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Removes all descriptions associated with a specific menu.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for a specific language across menus.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions associated with a specific menu.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all menu descriptions for a specific language.
